name: Keep the test server awake

# Render's free plan puts a server to sleep after 15 minutes without traffic, and a sleeping server forgets everything
# it holds in memory. This pings it every 10 minutes. It does nothing until the API_BASE_URL secret is set.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  ping:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - name: Ping the server
        env:
          URL: ${{ secrets.API_BASE_URL }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "API_BASE_URL is not set yet, nothing to ping."
            exit 0
          fi
          curl -fsS -m 90 --retry 2 "$URL/healthz" > /dev/null && echo "server answered" || echo "::warning::the server did not answer"
